facts.claim: The Coorg BebeUion was a rise of the Gaudas, a tribe on the Western slope of the Ghats who resemble the Coorgs in many of their habits.
facts.quote: The so-called Coorg BebeUion was properly speaking a rise of the Gaudas, a tribe on the Western slope of the Ghats who resemble the Coorgs in many of their habits.

facts.claim: After the annexation of Coorg, the districts of Amara Sulya, Puttur and Bantwdla were retransferred to the province of Canara.
facts.quote: After the annexation of Coorg, the districts of Amara Sulya, Puttur and Bantwdla, the latter adjoining that of Mangalore, had been retransferred to the province of Canara, from which they had been taken.

facts.claim: Under the Coorg Rajas, the assessment had been paid in kind, but the Collector of Mangalore now demanded cash payment.
